questions.q: What does reconciliation confirm in a Procure-to-Pay context?
options: That a requisition was submitted on time
That a supplier's catalog pricing is still current
That the documents and accounting created across the P2P cycle agree with each other and with the General Ledger
That an approval rule is configured correctly
questions.explain: Reconciliation checks that every stage's documents and accounting tie out consistently with each other and with the GL.

questions.q: Why should the Payables trial balance match the corresponding liability balance in the General Ledger?
options: They are unrelated numbers that coincidentally often match
Because every invoice must be entered twice, once in each system
Because the chart of accounts requires it by law
Because Subledger Accounting is what transferred Payables' accounting into GL in the first place
questions.explain: Since SLA is the mechanism that moves Payables accounting into GL, the two balances should agree unless something was untransferred or bypassed.

questions.q: What are common causes of an AP trial balance to GL mismatch?
options: A transaction accounted in Payables but not yet transferred to GL, a manual journal that bypassed the subledger, or a period-close timing difference
The supplier changing their remittance address
A requisition being submitted by the wrong requester
A purchase order being communicated by email instead of the Supplier Portal
questions.explain: Typical causes include untransferred subledger accounting, manual GL journals bypassing the subledger, or timing differences around period close.

questions.q: What does a lingering accrual balance for a receipt with no invoice weeks later usually indicate?
options: Nothing - lingering accruals are always expected and require no investigation
That the supplier may never have sent an invoice, or an invoice exists but is stuck somewhere, such as on a matching hold, before reaching accounting
That the item was never actually received
That the General Ledger has a permanent configuration error
questions.explain: A receipt accrual with no corresponding invoice after a reasonable period is a signal worth investigating - often a missing invoice or one stuck on a hold.

questions.q: What is the accrual balance for LTV's bearing receipt once Meridian's invoice has been matched and accounted?
options: It clears to zero, since the invoice accounting debited the same accrual account the receipt credited
It doubles permanently
It remains open indefinitely as a matter of policy
It transfers to a different supplier's account
questions.explain: Once the invoice is matched and accounted, its accounting clears the receipt's accrual, leaving a zero remaining balance for this transaction.
